method: Each outputs/<case>.json read against cases/<case>.json label by hand; one row per defect. Quality denominator excludes contract failures.

rows.detail: H3 (neighbour amenity) is the operative policy for a 4.5 m projection beyond an attached neighbour; retrieval supplied only D1, so H3 was never applied
rows.fix_candidate: deterministic applicability lookup from policies.json driven by the case facts

rows.detail: approve instead of refuse; downstream of the missed H3
rows.fix_candidate: same as the missed_policy row; expected to move with it

rows.detail: G4 refers to 'Table 2 of the Design SPD' (SPD-T2) but the table was not supplied; label cites G4 and SPD-T2
rows.fix_candidate: deterministic lookup of policy numbers/tables cited inside a retrieved policy's text

rows.detail: Condition imposes a 2.4 m by 43 m splay although statement-3 records a written highway-authority waiver; contradicts the facts and the G4 exception; the finding does not mention the waiver
rows.fix_candidate: give the output a place to record a written waiver so the decision can rely on it (schema), or an exemplar that shows a waived requirement

rows.detail: facts_used attributes the 7.8 m ridge height to roof-plan-G; it is stated in elevation-H
rows.fix_candidate: label each fact inline with its source ID instead of a separate SOURCE IDS list

rows.detail: Materials finding says 'No fact bears on this policy' although elevation-H states grey tile hanging against red clay tile; condition requires materials to 'match' when D1 requires samples to be agreed
rows.fix_candidate: none among the double's documented triggers; the double has no samples-condition behaviour. Recorded as a limit of the double

rows.detail: request 10,594 bytes exceeds REQUEST_BYTE_LIMIT 10,500; double returned truncated non-JSON; schema_valid false
rows.fix_candidate: shrink the request; the prompt is 1,600 words, of which Section 10 repeats Section 1 verbatim

observations_not_counted.note: conditions are free-text strings while the label uses {purpose, text}; the prompt's Section 7 asks for strings, so this is a schema-shape difference, not a decision defect. Condition text itself is enforceable and consistent with the reason
decision and both policies match the label

decision: Repair the contract failure first (excluded from the quality denominator). Then the largest decision-quality category is missed_policy (2 rows, plus the downstream wrong_outcome), so the first quality change is retrieval.
